notes.title: New Visual Customization
notes.content:
* Added the Gameplay submenu, which now includes a new Filters section.

* Introduced 10 visual filters to customize the gaming experience.

notes.title: Important Update
notes.content:
Important Update

Fixed the save system.
Added a level selection menu.
Adjusted the labyrinth complexity for a better experience.


Thank you for your feedback; it helps us continue improving the overall experience.

Additionally, new levels will be added in the coming months. We are currently conducting tests to ensure everything works properly in each level.

For any updates or questions, feel free to contact us.
